transcricao: Nothing will teach you how fucked life and the job market is more than working a really shitty labor-intensive job, but having no other option. I worked this miserable warehouse job for a few years. It was the graveyard shift in the middle of Chicago in the wintertime. It would be absolutely freezing, and all I would do was lift heavy boxes for eight hours straight. And there were many people that I met on that job that had college degrees, and they were fully capable men, but they were just underemployed. they could not find jobs elsewhere where they had expertise. And so they just took kind of what was available to them. And listen, we could talk all day about how shitty and soulless and dehumanizing the job is. I'm sure you guys know exactly what I'm talking about, right? I'm preaching the choir here. But the worst part about it is actually the mentality that you have when you go home. You're so exhausted. All you want to do is crawl into your bed. So not only is it taking away the time that you're actually at work, but when you're off of work, you're like, you know what? I'm just calling it a day. And with the job market looking the way it's looking, your only escape is to build something for yourself. And the only way you can build something for yourself is if you take actions and step into the identity of the person that you want to become. This is actually why I created My Future Self, so that you could be that person, so that you could step into the persona of the person that you want to become by putting in the daily actions. But if you don't take that leap of faith, then you're kind of fucked. You're going to be working these types of jobs for your entire life because nothing changes if nothing changes. And that's how 98% of Americans live.
